g.text: Prepare the plan
grid around the box of start, waypoints and landing:
radius = min(60 km, span + max(3 km, span)), ≤ 1 M cells
exact start and landing ground written into their cells
Straight line over the terrain
closed-form GR and its limiting point
(shown to the pilot; also the first guess)
Required GR by bisection
→ best grid route (one cell list per leg)
Straighten each leg
string pulling against ~2 samples per cell
Exact required GR of the route
max over samples of flown / (h − terrain − clearance),
and the arrival condition
Corridor of the last route
band ± 10 % of the path length (300 m – 1.5 km),
open within 1.5 × band of start, waypoints, landing
Block all corridors so far
(their cells get an elevation of 10⁶ m)
Required GR on the blocked grid
hint: at least the last route's search ratio
Straighten + exact GR
up to 2 alternatives (3 routes in all)
next
Route options
sorted by required GR; labelled by side and offset
("South-east side, 1.0 km off")
Pilot's own route
each GR change: one search for the shortest route at the
pilot's GR; it joins the list unless more than half of it
lies inside a corridor already found. Shown when it reaches
the landing; else the required route, dashed.
Terrain and the required-GR routes are cached per start, landing,
waypoints and assumptions: moving the GR slider re-runs only
the pilot's route. src/lib/compute/route.ts
